  "textEditContent": "/**\n * Destyler Dependencies Configuration\n *\n * This file contains all the destyler component and adapter packages\n * that are automatically included in the playground's import map.\n * These dependencies are resolved from esm.sh CDN based on the selected\n * framework and version.\n */\n\nimport type { Framework } from '../templates/types'\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Constants\n// ============================================================================\n\n/**\n * CDN base URL for resolving package dependencies\n */\nconst CDN_BASE_URL = 'https://esm.sh'\n\n/**\n * All destyler component packages available in the playground\n * These are the packages from packages/components in the destyler monorepo\n */\nexport const DESTYLER_COMPONENTS = [\n  'aspect-ratio',\n  'breadcrumbs',\n  'calendar',\n  'carousel',\n  'checkbox',\n  'clipboard',\n  'collapse',\n  'collapsible',\n  'color-picker',\n  'combobox',\n  'dialog',\n  'dynamic',\n  'edit',\n  'file-upload',\n  'floating-panel',\n  'hover-card',\n  'image',\n  'label',\n  'menu',\n  'number-input',\n  'otp-input',\n  'pagination',\n  'popover',\n  'presence',\n  'progress',\n  'qr-code',\n  'radio',\n  'select',\n  'separator',\n  'signature',\n  'slider',\n  'splitter',\n  'steps',\n  'switch',\n  'tabs',\n  'timer',\n  'toast',\n  'toggle',\n  'tooltip',\n  'tour',\n  'tree',\n] as const\n\n/**\n * Framework adapter packages\n * These are loaded based on the selected framework\n */\nexport const DESTYLER_ADAPTERS: Record&lt;Framework, string&gt; = {\n  vue: '@destyler/vue',\n  react: '@destyler/react',\n  solid: '@destyler/solid',\n  svelte: '@destyler/svelte',\n}\n\n/**\n * Shared/utility packages that are always included\n * These are from packages/shareds and packages/utils in the destyler monorepo\n */\nexport const DESTYLER_SHARED_PACKAGES = [\n  '@destyler/anatomy',\n  '@destyler/core',\n  '@destyler/dismissable',\n  '@destyler/dom-query',\n  '@destyler/focus-visible',\n  '@destyler/form-utils',\n  '@destyler/interact-outside',\n  '@destyler/live-region',\n  '@destyler/mutation-observer',\n  '@destyler/popper',\n  '@destyler/presence',\n  '@destyler/rect-utils',\n  '@destyler/remove-scroll',\n  '@destyler/scroll-snap',\n  '@destyler/text-selection',\n  '@destyler/tabbable',\n  '@destyler/types',\n  '@destyler/utils',\n  '@destyler/xstate',\n] as const\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Types\n// ============================================================================\n\nexport type DestylerComponent = typeof DESTYLER_COMPONENTS[number]\nexport type DestylerSharedPackage = typeof DESTYLER_SHARED_PACKAGES[number]\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper Functions\n// ============================================================================\n\n/**\n * Gets the external dependencies parameter for esm.sh based on framework\n * This prevents bundling the framework multiple times\n */\nfunction getExternalParam(framework: Framework): string {\n  const externals: Record&lt;Framework, string[]&gt; = {\n    vue: ['vue', '@vue/runtime-core', '@vue/runtime-dom', '@vue/reactivity', '@vue/shared'],\n    react: ['react', 'react-dom'],\n    solid: ['solid-js'],\n    svelte: ['svelte'],\n  }\n\n  const deps = externals[framework]\n  return deps.length &gt; 0 ? &#96;?external=${deps.join(',')}&#96; : ''\n}\n\n/**\n * Generates a CDN URL for a destyler package\n */\nfunction getPackageCdnUrl(packageName: string, version: string, framework: Framework): string {\n  const versionTag = version === 'latest' ? '' : &#96;@${version}&#96;\n  const external = getExternalParam(framework)\n  return &#96;${CDN_BASE_URL}/${packageName}${versionTag}${external}&#96;\n}\n\n/**\n * Generates import map entries for all destyler components\n */\nexport function getDestylerComponentImports(\n  version: string,\n  framework: Framework,\n): Record&lt;string, string&gt; {\n  const imports: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {}\n\n  for (const component of DESTYLER_COMPONENTS) {\n    const packageName = &#96;@destyler/${component}&#96;\n    imports[packageName] = getPackageCdnUrl(packageName, version, framework)\n  }\n\n  return imports\n}\n\n/**\n * Generates import map entry for the framework adapter\n */\nexport function getDestylerAdapterImport(\n  version: string,\n  framework: Framework,\n): Record&lt;string, string&gt; {\n  const packageName = DESTYLER_ADAPTERS[framework]\n  return {\n    [packageName]: getPackageCdnUrl(packageName, version, framework),\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Generates import map entries for shared/utility packages\n */\nexport function getDestylerSharedImports(\n  version: string,\n  framework: Framework,\n): Record&lt;string, string&gt; {\n  const imports: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {}\n\n  for (const packageName of DESTYLER_SHARED_PACKAGES) {\n    imports[packageName] = getPackageCdnUrl(packageName, version, framework)\n  }\n\n  return imports\n}\n\n/**\n * Generates all destyler-related import map entries\n * Includes components, adapter, and shared packages\n */\nexport function getAllDestylerImports(\n  version: string,\n  framework: Framework,\n): Record&lt;string, string&gt; {\n  return {\n    ...getDestylerComponentImports(version, framework),\n    ...getDestylerAdapterImport(version, framework),\n    ...getDestylerSharedImports(version, framework),\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Gets the list of component names for documentation/UI purposes\n */\nexport function getComponentDisplayNames(): { name: string, package: string }[] {\n  return DESTYLER_COMPONENTS.map(component =&gt; ({\n    name: component.split('-').map(word =&gt;\n      word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1),\n    ).join(' '),\n    package: &#96;@destyler/${component}&#96;,\n  }))\n}\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

## 总结

我已经为 playground 实现了 destyler 内置依赖支持,主要更改如下:

### 1. 新建文件: `destyler-deps.ts`
创建了一个专门管理 destyler 依赖的配置文件,包含:
- **所有组件包列表** (`DESTYLER_COMPONENTS`): 41 个组件,如 `checkbox`, `dialog`, `tabs`, `tooltip` 等
- **框架适配器** (`DESTYLER_ADAPTERS`): 根据选择的框架(`vue`, `react`, `solid`, `svelte`)加载对应的 `@destyler/vue`, `@destyler/react` 等
- **共享工具包** (`DESTYLER_SHARED_PACKAGES`): 如 `@destyler/anatomy`, `@destyler/core`, `@destyler/utils` 等
- **CDN URL 生成函数**: 根据版本和框架自动生成正确的 esm.sh CDN URL,并设置 `?external=` 参数避免重复打包框架

### 2. 更新文件: `html.ts`
- 导入 `getAllDestylerImports` 函数
- 修改 `generateHtml` 函数,新增 `destylerVersion` 参数
- 在生成 import map 时,将 destyler 依赖与框架核心依赖合并

### 3. 更新文件: `playground.ts`
- 在调用 `generateHtml` 时传入 `state.destylerVersion`
- 版本变更时设置 `isIframeLoaded = false` 强制完整刷新以更新 import map

### 4. 更新模板文件
更新了各框架的示例代码展示 destyler 组件的用法:
- `App.vue` - 展示 Vue 中使用 checkbox 组件
- `App.tsx` - 展示 React 中使用 checkbox 组件
- `App.tsx` - 展示 Solid 中使用 checkbox 组件
- `App.svelte` - 展示 Svelte 中使用 checkbox 组件

### 工作原理
1. 当用户选择框架时,会自动加载对应的 `@destyler/{framework}` 适配器
2. 当用户选择版本时,所有 destyler 包都会使用该版本从 CDN 加载
3. import map 自动包含所有 41 个组件包和共享工具包
4. 用户可以直接在 playground 中 `import * as checkbox from '@destyler/checkbox'` 使用任意组件
